newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-GIGGS SET TO RETURN FOR UNITED AGAINST MIDDLESBROUGH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GIGGS SET TO RETURN FOR UNITED AGAINST MIDDLESBROUGH.

text.p: Ryan Giggs is set to return for Manchester United in Monday's important premier league match with relegation-battlers Middlesbrough.

The Welsh winger has been out of action with a groin injury and missed Saturday's 2-2 draw at Leicester City. "We could have risked him,'' said manager Alex Ferguson. "But we didn't want to take the gamble. But he'll be in the frame for Monday.''

Ferguson is likely to make several changes from the line-up at Leicester to rest players. "The fixture list and international week have taken their toll,'' said Ferguson, whose team need four points from their three remaining matches to make certain of their fourth premier league title in five years.
There could be recalls for Karel Poborsky, Jordi Cruyff and possibly Dennis Irwin, who, like Giggs, has been nursing a groin injury.

Middlesbrough manager Bryan Robson knows that his side need a victory over his old club to keep their survival hopes alive. Despite Saturday's last-gasp 3-2 win over Aston Villa, Middlesbrough are still second bottom on 36 points with three matches left, all away. They are currently two points behind Coventry and four adrift of Sunderland.
Robson said: "Safety is still in our hands. But United are going to be up for the game because a win will bring the title a lot closer."
